note: The four documents an Indian child needs, in the order the offices insist on. leadDays counts from the day the one before it was settled, except the first, which counts from birth.

documents.title: Birth certificate
documents.why: Registers the birth with the municipality. Everything that follows asks for it.
needs: The hospital's discharge summary or birth letter
Both parents' ID and address proof
Registration within 21 days is free; after that a late fee, and past a year an affidavit

documents.title: Aadhaar
documents.why: Baal Aadhaar, linked to a parent's. No fingerprints until the child is five.

documents.title: Passport
documents.why: Applied for at a Passport Seva Kendra. A minor's passport runs five years.
needs: Address proof in a parent's name
Annexure D, signed by both parents

documents.title: PAN card
documents.why: Needed once anything is invested in the child's name. A parent applies as the representative.
needs: Birth certificate, as proof of date of birth
